Delivering real-time market analysis Computerlogy Talk to an Expert Computerlogy: Managing massive social media data and boosting profits with MongoDB Atlas Industry Technology Product MongoDB Atlas Use Case Analytics Cloud Data Strategy INTRODUCTION Unlocking social media value via analytics Computerlogy is a tech-driven company focused on marketing and data analytics. Its products and services enable companies to undertake market research, understand user preferences and behaviors, and execute marketing campaigns and strategies. From its early days as a start-up in Sriracha, Chonburi, Computerlogy recognized that the cloud would allow the scale and flexibility to drive international expansion.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Computerlogy's workload.

data_flow: Operational events and application data flow into MongoDB Atlas, where the platform stores current state and supports real-time queries for downstream applications and integrations such as Google Cloud.
